title: Seizures of Narcotics and Drugs (No. of Cases) during 1997-2001
pdf_title: Seizures of Narcotics and Drugs (No. of Cases) during 1997-2001
notes: The drug-wise analysis indicate that most of the Drug Trafficking had shown increasing trend in the year over
2000. Trafficking in Heroin, Ganja and Hashish had registered higher trend in the year over 2000.
On an average, the year 2001 witnessed 41 cases of drug seizures per day as against 34 such cases in 2000.
The quantity wise analysis of the drugs seized indicates that during this year, the seizure of drugs such as Hashish,
Methaqualone and Cocaine had registered increasing trend.
